units.source_text: 说着，女人到窗边去抓了一把沙子，扔进手边的食器里，唰地用沙子兜了一圈，实际操作给男人看。

en.t: As she spoke, the woman went to the window, grabbed a handful of sand, tossed it into the dish at her side, and briskly swirled the sand around in it, showing the man how it was done.

units.source_text: 尽管没去查看究竟有没有弄干净，但真让人觉得还不错。

en.t: Although he did not check whether it had actually been cleaned, it really did seem rather effective.

units.source_text: 那些沙子，至少和他一直保持的沙子的印象十分一致。

en.t: That sand, at least, matched perfectly the impression of sand he had always held.
